defensibleFindings: At the observed injury states, oxidation reaches the existing permitted power cap with food and oxygen available. Additional food alone at otherwise identical state cannot increase that oxidation. This does not prove sufficient food over later seasons.

Actual finite protection and its timing differ between individuals. Aggregate greater care/harvest can coexist with a worse individual trajectory.
Recorded physiology stage deltas exactly reconcile observed health, but summing those deltas is not an intervention that independently removes one cause.
A performed transfer passed the existing current-contact and finite-source checks. Missing transfers/effort do not reveal all available carers or why a recipient was not selected.
Offered handling capacity exceeds actual placement because the committer also applies target/contact/source bounds. Their difference is not a measured food-energy deficit.

The two arms share the initial world but subsequently differ in work, choices, contacts and assignment of RNG draws. Existing child IDs can be paired; later newborn identities and mechanisms cannot be assumed matched.

findings.claim: Ivo and Dara account for all 192 Amber child metabolic-injury intervals. Every one uses food intake at the maximum permitted oxidation with sufficient oxygen, no reserve use, no maintenance deficit and no unmet food request. Their 28.877087597182708-point combined health loss is exactly the summed cold-injury debit; sickness, dehydration, oxygen injury, recovery and outside-physiology health changes are zero.

Both remained at their own stationary unsheltered locations, bare throughout. Ivo's actual post-wear heat loss was 105.48120461506595–122.37017582832068 kJ per 15 minutes; Dara's 104.8459442669919–122.9194362722484. Each released 79.2 kJ each interval, already above 19.8 kJ resting maintenance. More intake alone cannot increase that fixed-state capped oxidation.

Yara entered already wearing 0.6839442108782997 kg fiber, experienced no new care transfer, and remained unsheltered/inactive at a different location. Post-wear heat loss stayed 37.055013497110465–45.90560683307876 kJ per interval, fully funded below the same power cap. Her health recovered 3.318658490510188 points. This is consistent with protection lowering demand; different place/body/history mean it is not an isolated care-treatment effect.

All three had finite personal food and replenished intake through normal recorded provision debits; no food handoffs were recorded. The trace therefore rules out immediate substrate absence for the two injured children during this day, not missing infant feeding/lactation/preparation biology or future food scarcity.

Persistent cold deficit also blocks retained reserve/tissue under the current finishMetabolism gate. Ivo and Dara retain zero mass this day; their initially different body/reserve amounts do not change. Yara retains 0.04986057471425434 kg reserve and 0.001018278224750645 kg structure from finite intake. The origins of their different opening reserve amounts were not observed here.

No recorded funded body-work effort or actual transfer reached these three during the day. Same-cell stationary contact, personal/camp fiber access, adult urgency and conditional choice constrain opportunities. Separate rest positions and low starting camp fiber are plausible bottlenecks; the trace lacks helper-candidate/rejection evidence and does not prove refusal, neglect, absence of nearby adults, or a particular ordering cause.

The 0.2 adult-body scale floor, 33 C skin temperature, fixed thermal resistance, four-times-resting maximum power, 240 kJ/health-point dose and recovery/retention gates are declared coarse conventions. Full food funding at the cap does not validate these coefficients or prove they are numerically defective. There is no resolved core temperature, neonatal thermogenesis, shared body warmth, infant attachment/carrying or infant feeding physiology.

proposedSmallestControls.question: Does feasible existing protection reduce this child's actual heat shortfall when food is already sufficient?
proposedSmallestControls.design: Use one recorded Ivo or Dara pre-wear interval in a disposable local fixture. Keep body composition, ambient state, oxygen, water, activity and total food/fiber identical. Compare fiber retained in a finite source against a prior valid paid covering placement using no more than the observed 0.1 kg camp fiber, with exact source debit. The earliest treatment benefit is the following physiology interval. Where intake capacity and ingestion limits permit, route additional existing personal food into the intake buffer at the same bare state as a cap control; never overfill a full buffer.
proposedSmallestControls.guards: Same material totals; no duplicated warmth/food; preserved paid work and contact for any executed placement; no immediate same-interval benefit from a later commit; no change to power/dose coefficients. More complete protection needs a verified additional existing source and real transport, not an assumed 0.684 kg grant.
proposedSmallestControls.discriminates: At fixed capped demand, additional intake should not increase oxidation; a finite wrap should change resistance and shortfall. A partial wrap need not eliminate injury. This measures a mechanism, not autonomous adoption, long-term survival or a real-world safe exposure.

proposedSmallestControls.question: Why did no funded covering attempt reach Ivo/Dara?
proposedSmallestControls.design: Observe only already-called local care evaluation during a short window: actual co-located stationary adults, their urgency gates, accessible finite fiber, target/benefit, reached conditional choice and contact/task/source rejection. Do not add searches, RNG draws, global child knowledge or mandatory work.
proposedSmallestControls.discriminates: Separates missing contact, scarce accessible material, higher-priority needs and an eligible declined choice. If no contact is the limiting gate, later test a voluntary local approach/attachment operation with actual travel/carrying cost; do not fix it by forced parent-only co-location or teleportation.

conclusions.claim: Rowan remains bare, inactive and unsheltered at(55,27), with positive personal provisions and intake. All81 intervals oxidize0.004956195244055069kg food, release79.2kJ, and record cold deficit without maintenance or oxygen deficit. At tick231013,118.80375765292055kJ required heat exceeds79.2kJ released; the actual metabolic stage exhausts remaining health.

No positive funded body-work capacity or gross covering transfer reaches Rowan in the sampled20.25hours. No food handoffs are recorded. These absences do not identify unlogged helper presence, eligibility, urgency, material access, rejected intentions or willingness.

Other newborns cannot be described by Rowan's food-funded mechanism alone. Person-133839 is born230976 and has52 observed intervals:14 at food-funded maximum power and38 below it,0.09416770963704635kg reserve oxidation, zero maintenance deficit but stronger cold shortfall. The child survives the window at83.61667779622722 health.

Finite extra food alone cannot increase Rowan's already-capped fixed-state oxidation. Food could increase power when the contrast child is limited to reserve release. Neither statement decides why protection/help failed, nor calibrates real newborn thermogenesis, skin/air resistance, body scaling, dose-to-injury or recovery.

The longer paired experiment records mortality AFTER despite earlier aggregate harvest/original-child improvements. This is an adverse outcome in this coupled world, not proof that performed harvesting directly injures people or that reverting it guarantees viability. Changed work, contact, supplies, births and RNG use require narrower controls.

findings.claim: Every one of the1,180 watched adult intervals has zero intake/reserves/provisions, zero ingestion/oxidation/released heat, no movement and a pending rest path. Physiological preparation labels them active from the route; funded activityFraction is zero. All16 terminal health stages reach zero during metabolism.

Every current-needs and optional-buffer claim selects no shared source. These are non-journey residents with an existing civilization, and feedIntake selects the camp independently of its amount when canReachCampStocks is true. Thus these recorded adults lack modeled camp-stock access at claim time; a zero source-budget field here must not be described as measuring an empty camp.

personalContact requires no pending path as well as unchanged coordinates. The observed pending paths therefore exclude these motionless adults from both food-handoff opportunity and physical work/commit checks. This compounds the inability to walk without fuel. The trace does not establish whether a willing, adequately supplied donor was co-located; it cannot assign a saved-death count to relaxing that condition.

Covering is present (approximately1.439–1.497kg) and water/oxygen injury is zero. This differs from Rowan's bare, fully food-funded power ceiling: these adults lack oxidizable substrate. Protection may reduce heat loss, but cannot itself provide the missing maintenance substrate.

Planned-active maintenance is still requested when actual movement/work output is zero. In165 observed intervals it exceeds heat loss; holding recorded heat/released energy fixed, replacing that request by resting demand lowers the raw model dose by at most0.017572712371568145points per interval. This exposes a bounded activity-demand coupling question, not a demonstrated independent share of the deaths.

The reserve partition, inability to mobilize structural matter, power limits, heat-loss model and dose-to-health law remain uncalibrated abstractions. This window verifies terminal accounting and exclusions, not a real-world starvation timescale.

minimalControls.question: Can a physically motionless, fuel-depleted resident receive local paid help while retaining a route?
minimalControls.design: Synthetic paired actual-function test with equal finite co-located donor food, funded donor work and recipient composition. Compare a pending rest path with zero actual movement against an explicitly stopped recipient. Current contact logic predicts exclusion only for the pending path. Preserve donor choices, finite debits, later ingestion and exact conservation; actual displacement/death/journey changes must still invalidate contact. This tests the path exclusion, not whether historical donors existed or would volunteer.

minimalControls.question: Does a planned action create unmet-demand injury when no work is physically performed?
minimalControls.design: Hold one recorded zero-output state, heat environment and substrate fixed; compare requested route activity with an inactive state. Check zero performed movement in both, no energy creation, resting versus optional work demand and exact injury. This is a planning/energy-accounting control, not license to provide free walking or bypass maintenance.

minimalControls.question: How did particular adults become isolated from finite food?
minimalControls.design: A bounded preceding interval needs actual source-access/footprint changes, carried stock depletion, planned route and local donor opportunities. The terminal trace does not reveal the earlier event that left them outside reach. Do not replace this missing history with global resource knowledge, mandatory pooling or an inferred refusal.
